questions.question: Which Azure service provides a unified, managed platform to build, train, and deploy machine learning models at scale, including no-code, low-code (designer) and code-first (SDK/CLI) experiences?
questions.explanation: Azure Machine Learning is the end-to-end managed ML platform on Azure. It provides automated ML, the visual designer, notebooks, the Python/CLI v2 SDK, MLOps pipelines, managed endpoints and a model registry. The other services do data search, big-data analytics, or data warehousing.

questions.question: You want to enrich an application with vision, language, speech and decision capabilities by calling pre-built REST APIs without training your own model. Which family of Azure services is designed for this?
questions.explanation: Azure AI services (formerly known as Cognitive Services) are pre-built, consumable AI APIs grouped into Vision, Language, Speech, and Decision categories. The other options are big-data, ETL, and workflow services.

questions.question: Which type of machine learning predicts a numeric value, such as the future price of a house from its features?
questions.explanation: Regression is a supervised learning technique that predicts a continuous numeric value (e.g., price, temperature). Classification predicts a discrete category, clustering groups unlabeled data, and reinforcement learning learns through rewards.

questions.question: A retailer wants to automatically group customers with similar buying behaviour, without any pre-existing labels. Which type of machine learning should be used?
questions.explanation: Clustering is an unsupervised learning task that groups items based on similarity in their features when no labels are provided. K-Means is a classic example. Classification and regression require labeled data.

questions.question: Which six principles does Microsoft define for Responsible AI?
options: Speed, scale, simplicity, security, savings, and support
Fairness, reliability and safety, privacy and security, inclusiveness, transparency, and accountability
Confidentiality, integrity, availability, authentication, authorization, and auditing
Bias, variance, accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score
questions.explanation: Microsoft's six Responsible AI principles are Fairness, Reliability and Safety, Privacy and Security, Inclusiveness, Transparency, and Accountability. AI-900 candidates must recognize these by name.

questions.question: Which Azure AI service can detect, recognize and analyze faces, including features such as age estimation, head pose and emotion (with limited access)?
questions.explanation: Azure AI Face provides face detection, identification and attribute analysis. Some attributes (emotion, gender, age, makeup) are now Limited Access features that require an application. Image Analysis is for general computer vision; Document Intelligence handles forms; Speech handles audio.

questions.question: Your team needs to extract structured data (key-value pairs, tables, fields) from invoices and receipts using pre-built and custom models. Which Azure service is purpose-built for this?
options: Azure AI Document Intelligence (formerly Form Recognizer)
questions.explanation: Azure AI Document Intelligence (formerly Form Recognizer) extracts text, key-value pairs, tables, and structured fields from documents using pre-built models (invoices, receipts, IDs, business cards) or custom models you train.

questions.question: Which Azure AI Language feature determines whether the overall opinion expressed in a piece of text is positive, neutral or negative?
questions.explanation: Sentiment analysis classifies text as positive, neutral, or negative and provides a confidence score. Key phrase extraction surfaces the main concepts, NER finds entities (people, places, dates), and language detection identifies the language.

questions.question: You need to convert spoken audio in real time to text in your call-center application. Which capability of Azure AI Speech should you use?
questions.explanation: Speech to text (transcription) converts spoken audio into text in real time or from files. Text to speech is the inverse (synthesizing audio); Speech translation translates spoken input across languages; Speaker recognition identifies or verifies speakers by voice.

questions.question: Which Azure service lets developers build conversational AI agents that can answer questions from a knowledge base of documents, FAQs and websites?
questions.explanation: The question answering feature of Azure AI Language (the successor to QnA Maker) builds a knowledge base from documents/URLs/FAQs and answers natural-language questions, often combined with Azure AI Bot Service for chat.

questions.question: A factory wants to automatically detect unusual spikes in equipment-sensor time-series data without training a custom model. Which Azure service should be used?
questions.explanation: Azure AI Anomaly Detector is a pre-built decision service that finds anomalies in time-series data (univariate or multivariate) with little or no ML expertise. The other services handle translation, harmful-content filtering, and custom image classification.

questions.question: You want to train a custom image classifier with a small set of labeled images and a no-code portal experience. Which Azure service is designed for this?
questions.explanation: Azure AI Custom Vision (customvision.ai) lets you upload images, tag them, and train a custom image classification or object detection model in a no-code portal, then export or call it via REST. Image Analysis offers prebuilt tags only.

questions.question: Which feature of Azure Machine Learning automatically tries multiple algorithms and hyperparameters to find a high-quality model with minimal coding?
questions.explanation: Automated ML (AutoML) iterates through algorithms, featurization, and hyperparameters to produce a leaderboard of models for classification, regression, time-series forecasting, NLP and computer-vision tasks. The Designer is a drag-and-drop pipeline builder.

questions.question: Which Microsoft Responsible AI principle is MOST directly addressed by providing model interpretability tools that explain why a model made a given prediction?
questions.explanation: Transparency means people understand how the AI system works and the basis for its decisions. Interpretability tools like SHAP and the Responsible AI dashboard in Azure ML support this principle. Accountability is closely related but is about governance and who is responsible.

questions.question: A company plans to use a large language model from OpenAI (such as GPT-4) inside its enterprise on Azure with private networking and Microsoft enterprise agreements. Which service should they use?
questions.explanation: Azure OpenAI Service provides access to OpenAI's GPT, Embeddings, DALL-E and Whisper models hosted on Azure with enterprise-grade security, regional availability, content filtering and integration with Azure networking and identity.

questions.question: Which technique enriches a generative AI model's answers with up-to-date private knowledge by retrieving relevant documents at inference time, instead of retraining the model?
questions.explanation: RAG retrieves the most relevant passages (often via vector search in Azure AI Search) and injects them into the prompt so the model answers using current and private content. Fine-tuning changes the weights, RLHF aligns model behavior, and prompt compression is unrelated.

questions.question: Which Azure AI service provides content filters that detect hate, violence, self-harm and sexual content in text and images, and is integrated with Azure OpenAI?
questions.explanation: Azure AI Content Safety analyzes text and images for harmful categories (hate, violence, self-harm, sexual) with severity levels and supports prompt-shield and protected-material detection for generative AI scenarios.

questions.question: Which Azure service is most appropriate to implement "knowledge mining" by indexing a large set of documents and adding AI enrichment (OCR, key phrases, entities) so users can search them?
questions.explanation: Azure AI Search (formerly Cognitive Search) is the knowledge-mining service: it ingests documents from data sources, applies AI skills (OCR, key phrases, entities, vectors) and exposes a queryable index. It is also commonly used as the retriever in RAG patterns.

questions.question: A model performs very well on the training data but poorly on new, unseen data. What is this phenomenon called?
questions.explanation: Overfitting means the model has memorized the training data, including its noise, and fails to generalize. Mitigations include more or better data, regularization, simpler models, cross-validation and early stopping. Underfitting is the opposite problem.

questions.question: Which metric is MOST appropriate to evaluate a binary classification model on a strongly imbalanced dataset (for example, fraud detection)?
questions.explanation: On imbalanced datasets, accuracy is misleading because predicting only the majority class still yields a high score. F1-score (the harmonic mean of precision and recall) is more meaningful. MAE and R-squared are regression metrics.
